dataset_license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (as stated in upstream README)

method.aggregation: maximum matching Train case score per unique syndrome

macro.definition: mean of per-syndrome recall across 148 classes in Dev

next_gemma_study.selection: official Dev Top-1, Macro-F1 and latency

limitations: Known duplicate texts and repeated user IDs remain in the official splits.
Micro/Macro Recall are retrieval metrics, not Gemma diagnostic accuracy.
Binary search applies to monotone Recall@K, not reranker Top-1.
No embedding, hybrid or Gemma evaluations have been run here.
